# Auto-generated event cover images — implementation plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:executing-plans (inline). Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Every event gets an automatically generated cover image that matches the mood of its title and description. The image does not need to be accurate or polished — it gives a feel for the event at a glance. Speed and low cost over quality. User request (24.11): "Generate an image for each event from its description".

**Scope note:** no F# — a user-requested feature outside the product-spec F# universe (do not add a spec table row, do not title this plan `# … (F<N>)`). Per the user's spec, verification is unit tests + a sample-image script, not a `[Fn]` Playwright test.

## Decisions

- **Columns on `events`** (migration 0041 — 0040 belongs to the parallel session; do not modify it): `image_url` (text), `image_prompt` (text), `image_seed` (integer), `image_status` (text, check `IN ('pending','ready','failed')`, null = never generated), `image_source_hash` (text), `image_key` (text — storage object key; **beyond the user's field list, required** to sign/serve; report it). All nullable, no defaults.
- **URL:** `image_url` is always the app route `/api/event-images/{eventId}` (no signed data in the DB). New route in both apps (one file each): reads the event (web: only if the event is open to the viewer, reuse `packages/api/src/events/access.ts`; admin: managers), then 302s to `presignDownload` (inline) when S3 is configured, or streams the bytes from the local dir otherwise.
- ~~**Local storage fallback:** env `EVENT_IMAGE_DIR` (default `data/event-images` resolved from cwd; `pnpm dev` runs from the repo root, so `data/event-images` there — add `data/` to `.gitignore`). When `storageConfig()` is null, images are written there as `{key}` files and served from the same route.~~
  - **26.11:** there is no default directory. Local storage is used only when `EVENT_IMAGE_DIR` is set, and it must be an absolute path (env validation refuses a relative one). With no bucket and no `EVENT_IMAGE_DIR` the feature counts as not configured (`eventImagesEnabled()` false: nothing queued, placeholder, no "regenerate"), serving answers 404 and the deletion worker keeps its records. Dropped because the cwd assumption was false: turbo runs every app in its own package directory, so the worker wrote to `apps/worker/data/event-images` while web and admin read from their own `data/event-images` and every image answered 404.
- **Pipeline:**
  1. **Prompt** — Anthropic Messages API (`https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages`), model `claude-haiku-5-5` (env override `EVENT_IMAGE_MODEL`), `max_tokens: 150`, the exact system prompt from the user spec, user content = title + description (any language, incl. Polish). In code: append the style suffix (env `EVENT_IMAGE_STYLE`, default `flat editorial illustration, soft grain, wide composition, no text, no lettering, no watermark`). **Fallback** if the LLM call fails (after its own retry is not required — one attempt, any failure triggers fallback): `atmospheric scene for <title with digits and quotes removed>, <style suffix>`.
  2. **Image** — provider interface `generateImage(prompt, { seed, width: 1024, height: 576 }) → { bytes, mimeType }`, selected by env `IMAGE_PROVIDER` (`fal` default | `cloudflare`):
     - `fal`: `fal-ai/flux/schnell` at `https://fal.run/fal-ai/flux/schnell`, header `Authorization: Key *** key `FAL_KEY`, body with `prompt`, `image_size` landscape 16:9 (1024×576 where the model supports it), `seed`; response `image.url` → download bytes. Verify the current request/response shape in the fal docs before coding.
     - `cloudflare`: Workers AI `@cf/black-forest-labs/flux-1-schnell`, `POST https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID}/ai/run/@cf/black-forest-labs/flux-1-schnell`, header `Authorization: Bearer {CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN}`, body `prompt`, `width`, `height`, `seed`; the response body **is** the PNG bytes. Verify in the Cloudflare docs before coding.
     - Use the provider's default step count for schnell. **Random 32-bit seed per generation, saved on the event.** 30 s timeout per attempt (`AbortSignal.timeout`), **1 retry** on network/5xx.
  3. **Store** — `putObject` (S3) or file write (local dir), key `event-images/{eventId}/{uuid}`.
  4. **Save** — update the event row: `image_url`, `image_prompt`, `image_seed`, `image_status = 'ready'`, `image_source_hash`.
- **Hash:** sha256 hex of `title + "\n" + (description ?? "") + "\n" + styleSuffix` (node:crypto). Only regenerate when it changes (or forced).
- **When:** after event create and after any update, **inside the transaction** via a hook argument on the db functions (the `RegistrationHooks` pattern — `@repo/db` must not import `@repo/jobs`; pass an optional `onImageSourceChanged(tx, eventId)` hook from the mutation layer). Condition: `EVENT_IMAGE_ENABLED` (default true, `z.enum(["true","false"])` — **never `z.coerce.boolean()`**, it turns `"false"` into true) and a provider is configured (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY + (`FAL_KEY` or both CLOUDFLARE vars)) and the new hash ≠ stored hash and status is not already `pending` for the same hash. The hook sets `image_status='pending'` + new hash in-tx and enqueues `{ eventId, force: false }` on a new queue `event-images`.
- **Worker** (`apps/worker/src/handlers/event-image.ts`): load the event; if not force and the stored hash ≠ current hash, recompute the prompt from the **current** values (stale-queue safety); build prompt → generate → store → update row (`ready` + fields) or set `failed` on provider error (image stays placeholder). Never throws unhandled. On replacement, the old `image_key` goes to `stored_file_deletions` (same trigger pattern as `event_files` — add a trigger on `events` in migration 0041 for delete and for `image_key` change; the existing `delete-stored-files` worker gets a local-dir branch when S3 is off).
- **Regenerate action:** new admin server function `regenerateEventImage` (event organizer/manager, same middleware as `updateAdminEventServer` in `packages/api/src/admin/mutations.ts`), **rate-limited 10/hour/user** via the existing `app_rate_limits` machinery (`packages/db/src/queries/rate-limits.ts` — read it first; if the existing helper doesn't fit, an upsert on `app_rate_limits` in the same style). Sets `pending` and enqueues `{ eventId, force: true }` (worker picks a fresh seed).
- **Env** (add to `packages/env/src/index.ts` server schema + `.env.example`, with comments): `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` (optional), `IMAGE_PROVIDER` (`fal`|`cloudflare`, default `fal`), `FAL_KEY` (optional), `CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID` (optional), `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` (optional), `EVENT_IMAGE_STYLE` (optional, code default above), `EVENT_IMAGE_ENABLED` (default `"true"`), `EVENT_IMAGE_DIR` (optional), `EVENT_IMAGE_MODEL` (default `claude-haiku-5-5`).
- **Feature off / provider unconfigured:** create/update succeed unchanged, nothing is enqueued, `image_status` stays null, UI shows the placeholder, regenerate answers a `DomainError` (new code, e.g. `EVENT_IMAGE_DISABLED` — extend `packages/api/src/errors.ts` **only if** the parallel session's uncommitted diff is not in that file at commit time, else hold and report).
- **UI:** image (16:9, `object-cover`) where events are shown; neutral placeholder while `pending`/`failed`/never (match the existing placeholder style of the agenda item page — pixel checkerboard band — reuse its look, do not import their untracked component). Admin: image + status + "regenerate" button for managers (disabled while pending).
- ~~**Event duplication:** no change to `event-duplicate.ts` (owned by the parallel session) — a copy goes through `createEvent` and gets its own generated image like any new event.~~
  - **26.11:** `duplicateEvent` takes the same optional `saveHooks` as `createEvent`/`updateEvent` and calls `onEventSaved` for every copy inside its transaction; `duplicateAdminEventServer` passes `eventImageHooks()`. Each copy gets its own image request; the insert never copies the source's image columns. Dropped because copies never went through `createEvent` (`duplicateEvent` inserts them itself), so they kept `image_status = null`; the parallel session's ownership of the file ended long ago.

## Findings

(facts corrected during execution land here, with the task that needed correcting — children read this section before their task)

- **fal API verified (24.11, fal.ai model page):** `POST https://fal.run/fal-ai/flux/schnell`, header `Authorization: Key *** value of `FAL_KEY` — **not** `Bearer`), JSON body: `prompt` (required), `image_size` — pass the object form `{ "width": 1024, "height": 576 }` (the enum `landscape_16_9` also exists), `seed` (integer; the response echoes the seed used), `output_format: "png"`; leave `num_inference_steps` at its default (4). Response JSON: `images: [{ url, content_type }]` — GET `images[0].url` to download the bytes — plus `seed`, `prompt`, `timings`.
- ~~**Cloudflare verified (24.11):** the old docs path (`workers-ai/models/text-to-image/flux-1-schnell`) is gone; the current page is `developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/models/flux-1-schnell/`. `POST https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID}/ai/run/@cf/black-forest-labs/flux-1-schnell`, header `Authorization: Bearer {CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN}`, JSON body `{ prompt, width: 1024, height: 576, seed }`; the HTTP response **is** the image bytes (`application/octet-stream`). Default step count (the page documents no step parameter — do not send one).~~ **Superseded 26.11** (the reply is not raw bytes, see below).
- ~~**Anthropic:** Messages API `POST https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages`, headers `x-api-key: *** ANTHROPIC_API_KEY>` and `anthropic-version: 2023-06-01`; body `{ model, max_tokens: 150, system, messages: [{ role: "user", content }] }` → `content[0].text`. Model `claude-haiku-5-5` is from the user spec (verify only at run time, not in tests).~~ **Superseded 26.11** (`content[0]` can be a thinking block, see below).
- **Anthropic corrected (26.11, platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking and …/thinking-troubleshooting):** thinking is on by default for `claude-haiku-5-5`; a reply can start with `{"type":"thinking","thinking":"","signature":"…"}` before the `{"type":"text"}` block, and thinking tokens count toward `max_tokens` (150). `claude-haiku-5-5` accepts `"thinking": {"type": "disabled"}` ("always on" models reject it with HTTP 400). The request now sends `thinking: {type: "disabled"}` and reads the first `type: "text"` block; no text block → fallback prompt.
- **Cloudflare corrected (26.11, developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/models/flux-1-schnell/ and …/workers-ai/get-started/rest-api/):** the REST reply is JSON in the usual envelope `{"result": {"image": "<base64>"}, "success": true, "errors": [], "messages": []}`; `image` is the generated image in base64 (the docs' examples treat it as JPEG). The code decodes `result.image` and sniffs the bytes; no `result.image` → error.
- **Reply limits (26.11):** a fal `images[0].url` that is not `https:` is refused before any request (no host allow-list — the fal docs name no fixed host); every provider reply body is read through one bounded reader, 10 MB max (`content-length` checked first, bytes counted while streaming).
- **Task 2 (done, `2ba9d54`/`42c7eb0`/`d9f635a`, on branch `event-images` in worktree `/home/godlew/projects/harmonogram_us-event-images`):** work runs in the **worktree**, not the main checkout — the main checkout was switched to the parallel session's `sync/next-to-main` branch mid-run; `next` stays at `7437702`. The save hook in `packages/db/src/queries/events.ts` is `onEventSaved(tx, event)` (the hook itself compares hashes) — `createEvent`/`updateEvent` call it inside the transaction; enqueueing is in `packages/jobs/src/client.ts` (`enqueueEventImage`, savepoint, no retries, never blocks the event save). `regenerateEventImage` reuses `updateAdminEventServer`'s access check + `consumeRateLimit` (10/hour/user, `app_rate_limits`). Pipeline always reads the event's **current** title/description (a job queued before a later edit uses the new text); stale-hash safety via `setEventImage`'s hash check. Worker: `apps/worker/src/handlers/event-image.ts` + `boss.work` in `index.ts`; `delete-stored-files.ts` deletes local files when no S3 bucket is configured (`removeLocalEventImage`, path-traversal guarded). Env defaults: `EVENT_IMAGE_ENABLED=true`, `EVENT_IMAGE_MODEL=claude-haiku-5-5`, `IMAGE_PROVIDER=fal`, `EVENT_IMAGE_DIR` optional local dir. **No `EVENT_IMAGE_DISABLED` error code exists yet** — Task 3 needs to add one to `packages/ui/src/app-errors.ts` (its code→message map) if a not-configured/disabled 4xx/5xx response is needed.
- **Task 3 (done, `ced3610`/`1d75d0f`):** serving = `packages/api/src/event-images/serve.ts` (new — the earlier plan's "serve.ts" reference was actually correct for Task 3): `publicEventImageResponse(eventId, invite?)` / `panelEventImageResponse(eventId)` reusing `visitorCanSee`/`managerCanSee` from `files/download`; 404 `private,no-store` for not-ready/invisible/missing-key; S3 → 302 `presignDownload(…, "image", {inline:true})`; local → bytes from `EVENT_IMAGE_DIR` via `localEventImagePath` (traversal-guarded, pulled out of `store.ts`), content-type sniffed from bytes. Route files: `apps/{web,admin}/src/routes/api/event-images/$eventId.ts`; the stored `imageUrl` is `/api/event-images/{eventId}` in the serving app. Web `EventCover` in `HomeEventCard` + `EventSummary` (passes `invite`); admin `EventCover` in `EventSummaryCard` with status line, regenerate button (managers only, disabled while pending, `?v=` cache-buster, error via `formatMutationError` toast, `RATE_LIMITED` already mapped) and admin query refetch every 5 s while `pending` (`imageGenerationEnabled` field added to `packages/api/src/admin/queries.ts`). Placeholder = the `@repo/ui` composed checkerboard band, not an import of the F18 component. i18n: 4 new keys in pl+en. App package names for pnpm filters: `web`, `admin`.
- **Task 4 (done, `d750b81`):** `packages/api/scripts/generate-sample-event-images.ts` (tsx; real LLM + real provider, no DB, serial, exit 1 on any failure, fail-fast on missing keys naming the exact variables; writes `data/sample-event-images/` — gitignored via `data/`). Root script `sample:event-images` uses `pnpm --dir packages/api exec tsx …` — **pnpm `--filter X exec` prints a stray `undefined` to stdout on non-zero exit** (reproduced with a 2-line file; `--dir` and bare `pnpm exec` are clean). Deviations: `tsx` added as a devDependency of `@repo/api` (already in the lockfile via db/worker/e2e — same version, 3-line lockfile change) because the workspace imports are extensionless and plain node can't run the script; `packages/api/tsconfig.json` now includes `./scripts/**/*.ts`. Biome never checks `scripts/` or `test/` folders (root `biome.json` only includes `**/src/**`) — the pre-commit hook passes them unchecked. `buildImagePrompt` never reports the LLM error — the script detects the fallback via its `atmospheric scene for ` prefix, so `prompts.txt` carries no LLM error text.
- **Cost per image (verified 25.11, public docs):** fal `fal-ai/flux/schnell` = $0.003 per megapixel, billed rounding **up** to the nearest MP → 1024×576 (0.59 MP) = **$0.003**. Cloudflare `@cf/black-forest-labs/flux-1-schnell` = 4.80 neurons per 512×512 tile + 9.60 per step; 1024×576 = 4 tiles × 4 steps ≈ 57.6 neurons per the docs table (≈$0.0006 at $0.011/1000) — but an independent Oct-2026 measurement metered 172.8 neurons for a 1024×1024/4-step image (3× the table), so expect **~58–173 neurons** (≈$0.0006–0.0019); **10,000 neurons/day free** (resets 00:00 UTC) → roughly 57–170 images/day free. Prompt call `claude-haiku-5-5` = $0.10/MTok in, $0.50/MTok out (≤100K prompts) → ~350 in + ≤150 out tokens ≈ **<$0.0001**. Totals: **fal ≈ $0.0031/image; Cloudflare ≈ $0.0006–0.002 + prompt, usually $0 (free quota)**.
- **PR #50 review fixes (26.11):** (1) `admin/mutations.ts` and `admin/queries.ts` import `@repo/api/event-images/queue` instead of `../event-images/queue` (domain-boundaries rule). This is the first self-import by package name inside `packages/api/src`; it resolved with no config change in `@repo/api` typecheck + tests, worker typecheck/tests/esbuild build, web and admin typecheck + build. (2) `regenerateEventImageServer`'s handler calls `assertCanManageEvent` itself (it also stays in `regenerateEventImage`), and `event-images/regenerate.ts` is in the panel-access guard list in `test/event-access.test.ts`. Before this, the guard did not scan the file, and a comment would have satisfied its text match. (3) `removeLocalEventImage` no longer uses `rm --force`: a missing file throws, so a worker run without a bucket forgets a deletion record only when the local file existed and was removed. The deletion table is shared with event files and programme item images stored in the bucket. (4) The pipeline's save (`setEventImage`, now the injected `save` dep) runs inside the `try`: a failed save marks the request `failed` instead of leaving it `pending` forever, which kept regenerate disabled. The `setEventImage` comment now says that a superseded result leaves the status `pending` and nothing is served.
- **Duplicates and the image directory (26.11):** duplicated events now request covers through the save hook, and `EVENT_IMAGE_DIR` has no default and must be absolute; see the 26.11 notes under "Local storage fallback" and "Event duplication".
- **Admin event page crashed in the browser (26.11):** PR #50 had been opened without an e2e run. CI (run 45785937461, `fb8c2d7`) failed 84 e2e tests. The admin event page showed the error boundary with "process is not defined". Cause: `event-cover.tsx` imported `regenerateEventImageServer` from `event-images/regenerate.ts`, which also exports the plain `regenerateEventImage`. The compiler strips only server-function handlers, so the module's other imports stayed in the client chunk: `./queue` → `@repo/env` → `loadEnv.ts`, whose top-level `process.cwd()` threw, along with `pg` and pg-boss. The fix follows `admin/agenda-item-image.ts`: the server function moved to `admin/event-image.ts`, which exports only that function, and that file replaces `regenerate.ts` in the panel-access guard list. The admin event chunk shrank from 693 kB to 118 kB and has no env, `pg` or pg-boss code. The web client had no such import.
- **Shared test DB flakiness:** while the parallel session runs `pnpm validate`/its test suites, `harmonogram_us_test` can transiently break other suites (23 api tests failed once, full re-run green). On a green→red→green wobble with no local diff, re-run before investigating.
- **Task 1 (done, `917e61e`):** the parallel session's 0040 was already **committed** (`fad43ab "feat: programme item page with details, speakers' bios and an image"`) by the time Task 1 ran — the "uncommitted 0040" assumption in the Global constraints is stale; the hold-rule checks in this plan still apply to whatever is uncommitted at commit time. Deletion triggers are appended to the generated migration SQL **by hand** (drizzle does not generate them) — the model is 0040's `record_agenda_item_image_deletion` (handles replace **and** delete), not 0038's `event_files` trigger (delete only). `drizzle-kit generate --name <slug>` gives a descriptive migration tag (plain `pnpm db:generate` produced `0041_gorgeous_skrulls`). Task 1's helpers in `packages/db/src/queries/event-images.ts`: `getEventImageSource`, `markImagePending(executor, eventId, sourceHash, { force? })` (returns true only when it changed the row — enqueue only then), `setEventImage` (stores the result; sets `ready` only when the stored hash still matches, so a stale result never clobbers a newer pending request), `failEventImage(eventId, sourceHash)`. UI exposure: `imageUrl`/`imageStatus` on the one shared event query (`queryEvents` in `packages/db/src/queries/events.ts`) feeding web list, web detail and admin detail.

Requirements: the columns and check from Decisions; a trigger on `events` recording `image_key` into `stored_file_deletions` on delete and on change (pattern: the `event_files` trigger in migration 0040 territory / F14); query helpers in `queries/event-images.ts`; new fields exposed on the event rows returned to the UI (web list, web detail, admin detail — find the exact query functions, no new query surface beyond that).

Acceptance: `pnpm db:generate` produces exactly one new migration (0041) — its SQL inspected and sane; `pnpm db:migrate` applies to the dev DB; `pnpm --filter @repo/db test` passes (the test global-setup migrates `harmonogram_us_test` from the working-tree journal, which already contains the parallel session's 0040 — that is expected locally).

- [x] Write the db test first (migrate applies; a new event has null image fields; `markImagePending`/`setEventImage`/`failEventImage` transitions; the deletion trigger records the old key), observe failure.
- [x] Schema change, `pnpm db:generate`, inspect SQL, trigger, queries; `pnpm --filter @repo/db test` passes.
- [x] Commit (message: `feat(db): event cover image columns and deletion tracking`). `_journal.json` and the schema files of the parallel session: HOLD rule. → committed `917e61e`; `_journal.json` was committed (its diff contained only the 0041 entry — the parallel session had already committed 0040 in `fad43ab`).

### Task 2: Pipeline — prompt, providers, storage, queue, worker, regeneration

  2. A worker that dies mid-job leaves the event `pending`, and "regenerate" is disabled while pending; only a text edit recovers it. Needs a product decision (allow regenerate while pending, a pending timeout, or a dead-letter handler).
  3. One stored object is orphaned when saving the result fails after storing it, or when the event is deleted during generation (CodeRabbit).
  4. A queued job that reads the event while a later save is still in its transaction can mark a cover made from the previous text as ready; the next edit or "regenerate" replaces it (CodeRabbit).
  5. No assertions for: the UI states (placeholder, button, 360 px), the exact system prompt text, the route wiring to the real access checks (the serve tests inject `canSee`).
  6. Minor: covers are served `private, no-store` (handoff step 5d plans a cacheable URL); the 404 path reads the image key before the access check; a regenerate that merges into a queued job still spends a rate-limit point; with neither bucket nor directory the deletion worker still reads its batch and counts it failed; `.gitignore` ignores every `data/` directory.
